source: db/derivatives.db snapshots: stock options (CE/PE, non-index) with bid>0, ask>=bid, joined to the underlying spot at the same capture; half-spread = (ask-bid)/2/mid
bucket_by: premium as a % of the underlying spot (point-in-time: independent of later splits/bonuses - quant audit C4)
